## Prior review feedback

The previous blocking defect is resolved. Issues `92039d9c`, `56838d99`, `0d8f20a8`, `eceffc17`, `9b0a997e`, `7ad4019b`, `070ca05f`, and `bcff56be` now contain real Markdown line breaks and recognized `## Success Criteria` sections; none retains literal `\n` separators.

## Content standards

All twelve implementation issues comply with [jit-content-standards.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.agents/worktrees/agent-9b7b5f9c/docs/reference/jit-content-standards.md):

- Each has a real `## Success Criteria` section with observable `[hard] REQ-NN` criteria.
- Titles contain no ordinals, parent IDs, `feat(...)`, or `type:` prefixes.
- Descriptions provide background, scope, and landing outcomes without sibling IDs, sibling shorthand, or prose dependency lists.
- All carry `type:task`, `epic:jit-profiles`, and `milestone:v1.0`. Both membership values are meaningful kebab slugs.
- The configured hierarchy assigns identifying-label namespaces only to milestone, epic, and story types; task leaves therefore do not require their own strategic label.
- The container retains its own `epic:jit-profiles` identity.

No blocking or advisory content defect was found.

## Coverage versus the design

The approved decomposition in [§3 of the plan](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.agents/worktrees/agent-9b7b5f9c/dev/active/9b7b5f9c-plan.md:40) specifies twelve task leaves.

| Design item | Issue | Matches? |
|---|---:|---|
| Define and validate embedded profile packages | `0aec3b1e` | Yes — title, scope, three criteria, gates, and root status match. |
| Route repository validation through an overlay view | `be542b98` | Yes — both validation-view outcomes and root status match. |
| Plan safe deterministic profile application | `56838d99` | Yes — package/view prerequisites and planner boundary match. |
| Add the durable file-set transaction kernel | `866a5bbd` | Yes — transaction, recovery, capability-safety, and test scope match. |
| Enforce recovery at the universal mutation boundary | `eceffc17` | Yes — kernel prerequisite and CLI/server recovery scope match. |
| Apply profiles with transactional provenance and audit | `9b0a997e` | Yes — planner/recovery prerequisites and atomic event/provenance scope match. |
| Expose profile commands through init, schema, and MCP | `070ca05f` | Yes — public CLI/init/schema/MCP contract matches. |
| Provide portable deterministic checks and review warnings | `92039d9c` | Yes — generic checker and visible-warning outcomes match. |
| Build package projection and drift mechanics | `0d8f20a8` | Yes — synthetic-only mechanics boundary matches. |
| Author the portable dogfood workflow package | `7ad4019b` | Yes — production payload, projections, skills, gates, and live-consumer migration match. |
| Consolidate adopter profile documentation | `c533ac18` | Yes — canonical-reference and advanced-customization scope match. |
| Exercise cross-platform profile adoption | `bcff56be` | Yes — bounded public-surface acceptance journey matches. |

There are no missing, extra, wrongly merged, or mis-scoped implementation items. The planning and breakdown nodes are expected bracket infrastructure, not extra design work items.

## Dependency DAG correctness

Using `dependent → prerequisite`, the implementation has exactly the design’s transitively reduced ordering:

- Roots: `0aec3b1e`, `be542b98`, `866a5bbd`, `92039d9c`
- `56838d99 → {0aec3b1e, be542b98}`
- `0d8f20a8 → 0aec3b1e`
- `eceffc17 → 866a5bbd`
- `9b0a997e → {56838d99, eceffc17}`
- `7ad4019b → {9b0a997e, 92039d9c, 0d8f20a8}`
- `070ca05f → 7ad4019b`
- `c533ac18 → 070ca05f`
- `bcff56be → c533ac18`

All four roots can begin in a fresh checkout without sibling output: they work against existing crate, validation, storage, or gate infrastructure and create their own new abstractions or fixtures. No root assumes a crate, directory, package payload, or generated artifact owned by another leaf.

No missing prerequisite or false serialization was found.

## Structural integrity

The bracket spine is intact:

- `96326159 → ca024a2b`
- Every implementation source depends on `96326159`.
- Container `9b7b5f9c` depends on the sole sink, `bcff56be`.
- All twelve implementation tasks resolve under `9b7b5f9c`; none is isolated or dangling.

The flat shape is expressly justified in plan §3: “Each item below is a `type:task` leaf” and “Every item leaves the repository green and independently reviewable.” Decision D11 further fixes the twelve-leaf ownership boundaries. The large leaves remain cohesive landing units: the transaction kernel owns one storage protocol, public exposure owns one generated cross-surface contract, and the package leaf deliberately moves the authored payload and derived consumers together to avoid a second source of truth. The rationale therefore holds.
